In the figure, A4 is located on the base A1A2, A5 is located on the side A2A3, and A6 is located on the segment A3A4; this is consistent with the rules that A4 is the midpoint of A1A2, A5 is the midpoint of A2A3, and A6 is the midpoint of A3A4. Reasoning: Let v_n denote the vector from A_n to A_{n+1}. By the midpoint condition, A_{n+3}=(A_n+A_{n+1})/2 and A_{n+4}=(A_{n+1}+A_{n+2})/2, so v_{n+3}=A_{n+4}-A_{n+3}=(v_n+v_{n+1})/2. To verify 8-step self-similarity, take equilateral triangle coordinates A1=(0,0), A2=(2,0), A3=(1,√3). Then v1=(2,0), v2=(-1,√3), v3=(0,-√3). Recursively obtain v4=(1/2,√3/2), v5=(-1/2,0), v6=(1/4,-√3/4), v7=(0,√3/4), v8=(-1/8,-√3/8), v9=(1/8,0)=v1/16, v10=(-1/16,√3/16)=v2/16, v11=(0,-√3/16)=v3/16. Since the same linear recurrence will continue to propagate this relation, for this construction there is v_{n+8}=v_n/16. Because 43=3+5·8, 44=4+5·8, and 45=5+5·8, triangle A43A44A45 is a same-direction reduced copy of triangle A3A4A5. Therefore ∠A44A45A43=∠A4A5A3. Also A4 and A5 are respectively the midpoints of A1A2 and A2A3, so A4A5 is parallel to A1A3. Thus ray A5A4 is parallel to A3A1, and ray A5A3 is along the direction of A2A3. In an equilateral triangle, the included angle between adjacent sides is 60°, and A2A3 is opposite in direction to A3A2, so the angle between A3A1 and A2A3 is 180°-60°=120°.

method.method_draft: Use an analytic complex-coordinate recurrence. From the diagram/text choose coordinates for the equilateral triangle, for example z1 = 0, z2 = 1, z3 = exp(iπ/3). The text recurrence becomes z_{n+3} = (z_n + z_{n+1})/2. Let w_n = z_{n+1} - z_n. Then w_{n+3} = (w_n + w_{n+1})/2. Solve the characteristic equation 2r^3 - r - 1 = 0; for differences the constant root is absent, and the two nontrivial roots are (-1+i)/2 and (-1-i)/2, both of whose eighth powers are 1/16. Hence w_{n+8} = w_n/16, so w43 = w3/16^5 and w44 = w4/16^5. Compute from the initial coordinates: w3 = z4 - z3 = -i√3/2 and w4 = z5 - z4 = (1/2)exp(iπ/3). 其特征方程为 2r^3-r-1=0=(r-1)(2r^2+2r+1)，非平凡根为 r=(-1+i)/2 和 r=(-1-i)/2。由于 w_n 是相邻 z 的差，z_n 中的常数根部分在差分中消失，所以 w_n 只含这两个非平凡根。两根的八次方均为 1/16，因此 w_{n+8}=w_n/16。

因为 43=3+8·5，44=4+8·5，所以 w43=w3/16^5，w44=w4/16^5。由初始坐标：z4=(z1+z2)/2=1/2，所以 w3=z4-z3=1/2-(1/2+i√3/2)=-i√3/2；又 z5=(z2+z3)/2，所以 w4=z5-z4=(1/2)exp(iπ/3)，方向为 60°。

角 ∠A44A45A43 的顶点是 A45。向量 A45A44=z44-z45=-w44，向量 A45A43=z43-z45=-(w43+w44)。共同乘以负号或正比例缩放不改变夹角。w4 方向为 60°，而 w3+w4=-i√3/2+(1/2)exp(iπ/3)=1/4-i√3/4，方向为 -60°。两方向夹角为 120°，所以 ∠A44A45A43=120°。

raw_record.original_question: If $\triangle A_1A_2A_3$ is equilateral and $A_{n+3}$ is the midpoint of line segment $A_nA_{n+1}$ for all positive integers $n$, what is the measure of $\measuredangle A_{44}A_{45}A_{43}$?
raw_record.final_cot: First describe the figure: In the attached figure, A1A2A3 is an equilateral triangle, A1 is at the lower left, A2 is at the lower right, and A3 is at the top. In the figure, A4 is located on the base A1A2, A5 is located on the side A2A3, and A6 is located on the segment A3A4; this is consistent with the rules that A4 is the midpoint of A1A2, A5 is the midpoint of A2A3, and A6 is the midpoint of A3A4. Reasoning: Let v_n denote the vector from A_n to A_{n+1}. By the midpoint condition, A_{n+3}=(A_n+A_{n+1})/2 and A_{n+4}=(A_{n+1}+A_{n+2})/2, so v_{n+3}=A_{n+4}-A_{n+3}=(v_n+v_{n+1})/2. To verify 8-step self-similarity, take equilateral triangle coordinates A1=(0,0), A2=(2,0), A3=(1,√3). Then v1=(2,0), v2=(-1,√3), v3=(0,-√3). Recursively obtain v4=(1/2,√3/2), v5=(-1/2,0), v6=(1/4,-√3/4), v7=(0,√3/4), v8=(-1/8,-√3/8), v9=(1/8,0)=v1/16, v10=(-1/16,√3/16)=v2/16, v11=(0,-√3/16)=v3/16. Since the same linear recurrence will continue to propagate this relation, for this construction there is v_{n+8}=v_n/16. Because 43=3+5·8, 44=4+5·8, and 45=5+5·8, triangle A43A44A45 is a same-direction reduced copy of triangle A3A4A5. Therefore ∠A44A45A43=∠A4A5A3. Also A4 and A5 are respectively the midpoints of A1A2 and A2A3, so A4A5 is parallel to A1A3. Thus ray A5A4 is parallel to A3A1, and ray A5A3 is along the direction of A2A3. In an equilateral triangle, the included angle between adjacent sides is 60°, and A2A3 is opposite in direction to A3A2, so the angle between A3A1 and A2A3 is 180°-60°=120°.
